title: Mixed Leray composition coherence on K-injective complexes
statement: For schemes X,Y,Z [def-pc-scheme], composable morphisms f:X→Y, g:Y→Z, and an explicitly K-injective cochain complex I of O_X-modules, put F=Qh(quotient I) in D(O_X) [def-pc-derived-category]. With independent sheaf and module localization universes, c_h the normalized mixed Leray comparison [lem-sc-mixed-global-sections-direct-image-iso], e(f,g) the normalized direct-image composition comparison [lem-sc-derived-direct-image-square-mate] [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-direct-image-composition], and s(f,g) scalar restriction along a composite [def-pc-global-hom-pullback-comparison], one has c_g(Rf_*F);S_g(c_f(F))=RΓ_Z(e(f,g)_F);c_(f;g)(F);s(f,g)_(RΓ_X F). This is only the K-injective unit calculation: it does not transport the equality to an arbitrary derived object.

source.place: Tags 0D5T and 0D5W, unit-normalization calculation on K-injective complexes; argument written by second reader from the stated unit equations. Primary sources https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0D5T and https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0D5W read 2026-10-13.

proof.text: Form p as the ΓZ unit at Dfg(K), followed by RΓZ(unit_Dfg(K)) and RΓZ(e.inv(F)). The first factor is invertible by direct-image global-sections acyclicity on a K-injective complex. The direct-image unit is invertible on K-injectives; functors preserve isomorphisms and e.inv is an isomorphism. Thus p is invertible and is an epimorphism.

The left and right normalization theorems identify each path after precomposition with p with the same factor path b. Compose one equality with the symmetric other equality, then cancel p using cancel_epi. This is the full Lean proof of the parent; the two independent path-normalization calculations remain separate items.

proof_origin.note: Complete Lean cancellation proof from two strictly partial unit-normalization equations. This is a decomposition: one upper hole closed and two lower holes added; original signature unchanged.

lean.statement:
theorem mixedSections_composition_coherence_on_kInjective
    {X Y Z : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y) (g : Y ⟶ Z)
    (I : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    [I.IsKInjective] :
    let F := DerivedCategory.Qh.obj ((HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ)).obj I)
    let e : schemeDerivedDirectImage f ⋙ schemeDerivedDirectImage g ≅
        schemeDerivedDirectImage (f ≫ g) :=
      schemeNormalizedDirectImageCompIso f g
    (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso g).hom.app ((schemeDerivedDirectImage f).obj F) ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarRestriction g).map
          ((mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso f).hom.app F) =
      (schemeDerivedGlobalSections Z).map (e.hom.app F) ≫
        (mixedGlobalSectionsDirectImageIso (f ≫ g)).hom.app F ≫
        (schemeGlobalScalarRestrictionCompIso f g).hom.app
          ((schemeDerivedGlobalSections X).obj F)
